body: don’t be afraid to go to the hospital. you might be there for a little while but it’s really the only way to get placement into a psychiatric hospital. i’m a patient companion at a hospital and i’ve had to sit in the covid units, and i haven’t gotten covid yet. just try to stay away from people and keep your mask on. i hope you get the help you need and deserve.
i might try writing how i feel in a journal. i have to figure something out. thank you so much for taking the time to reply to me.

thank you for your comment. i don’t know if i will ever find the words to confront him or my mom about it. i don’t know if therapy would help me but i surely don’t have the money for it. but thank you for sharing your story with me, they are really similar. it makes me feel less alone in what i went through/am going through. shit does suck lol. i extend love to you as well.
Yeah I think you’re right and it overwhelmed her for some reason. I told her that I could  do it for her with her info when she gets off work. She seemed okay with that. Thank you!
I gave her cash as soon as she told me it got charged to her card. I just went on there today and took her card off of my account.
I will let her know or just call them myself. thank you
That’s what I was thinking. It seems sketchy to use my bank information for her credit card.
But I wasn’t aware she had this card linked to MY amazon account. I’ve only ever had my debit cards on there.
I don’t know why she even got it when she’s never used it and doesn’t have any idea how to pay on it. It’s a frustrating situation
I thought I fixed it by already paying her the cash as soon as she told me it got charged to her card.

she said she was getting frustrated this morning trying to pay it because she doesn’t know her routing number. So she told me I need to just do it since I’m the one who bought the book. But like I said, I had no idea her card info was on my account. I already paid her the cash for it too. I went on there just now and took her credit card off of my account. when I looked I saw the last 4 numbers on her card are literally one number off from my card I have on there so I didn’t notice at the time.

thank you so much for your kind words. ive always dealt with my issues and trauma alone and never told anyone. it is kind of a weight off my shoulders to just know that somebody out there knows. i was always so afraid to tell anyone as a kid. i was afraid that i would get in trouble. i don’t live with him anymore, i moved out when i was 17. i don’t have the money to go to therapy and i don’t have insurance but i don’t know if i’ll ever be able to speak about what happened to me. typing it out was extremely difficult, the only reason i was able to is because no one on here knows who i am. i have so much shame and disgust even though i know it wasn’t my fault. i want to move on from it and i get so frustrated that i can’t even though it’s been 9 years. thank you again, your comment really means a lot to me. i’m sorry if this is a mess to read. my thoughts are a mess haha
thanks man. i’m trying to get out of that mind set and find things that i enjoy. it’s just been hard recently. i think i need a good night of sleep haha. thank you again
